(including carriage of mixed materials up to 10.0 Km initial lead from mixing plant )( Including cost of testing of materials at site and laboratory as directed by the department.) - With rock dust as filler (refer table 500-9 of MoSRT&H specification) & anti stripping agent as per IS:14982 (Refer - With 60/70 or VG-30 grade bitumen - for Grading I (19 mm nominal size)
